mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with temperatures at 52 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 55.

The city wants to remind everyone about two important updates: winter parking regulations will be in effect from November 20 through April 1, and the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do in Verona! You can catch live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, enjoy some yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, or head to the Wisconsin Brewing Company on November 4 for trivia.
In our weekly report, on October 25, officers arrested a man for his first offence O W I after locating him behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
